text:
Sam: hit a reproducible hang in staging during aggressive demotes. short stack: ```prefetch.lock(shard)
evict.lock(tenant)
// both block waiting on each other```
Alisha: interesting. is this the same inverted-order thing?
Sam: looks like it but it's triggered only when prefetch concurrency >4 and demote interval <6s.
Ben: we should consider an optimistic handoff: eviction issues `HANDOFF_REQUEST` and proceeds if prefetch doesn't reply in X ms.
Chen: optimistic handoff means possible duplicate ownership momentarily. we need lease-generation to disambiguate and idempotent apply.
Lena: another idea: split shard lock into read/write so prefetch holds read and eviction takes write; avoids ordering changes but requires upgrade-safe locks.
Alisha: telemetry request: add sampled "lock_stack" capture when blocked >10ms so we can detect cycles in prod before full outage.
evict-bot: created INF-2401: "staging: prefetch-evict optimistic-handoff experiment"
Sam: short-term: add bounded wait + requeue for eviction to stop full stall. long-term: bench optimistic-handoff vs read/write locks.
Ben: i'll draft proto for HANDOFF_REQUEST + failure cases. make it idempotent and include holder_epoch.
Chen: i'll prototype upgrade-safe RW lock and a try-upgrade loop with jitter.
Lena: include tests for duplicate-ownership and rollback path.
Sam: assign owners and we'll reconvene after benches. thanks.
